chapters.title: Biopsychology & Neuroscience
chapters.blurb: Neurons, action potentials, neurotransmitters, brain anatomy, cranial nerves, the HPA axis, sleep and neuro/genetic disorders, fused into one primer.

chapters.blurb: Memory, attention, perception, language, thinking and reasoning, the full cognitive deep dive.

chapters.title: Personality — the full book, chapter by chapter
chapters.blurb: Trait, type, psychodynamic, humanistic and behavioural theories of personality, the full deep dive.

chapters.title: Social & General Psychology
chapters.blurb: Attribution, attitudes, conformity, groups, prejudice plus the general-psych core and every landmark study, merged.

chapters.title: Psychological Assessment & Testing

chapters.title: Therapy, Counselling & Ethics
chapters.blurb: Learning and conditioning, every therapy school from Freud to SFBT, common factors and ethics, merged.

chapters.title: Research Methods & Statistics
chapters.blurb: Research design, sampling, distributions, every statistical test, and degrees of freedom from scratch, merged.

shelves.name: Amity
shelves.subtitle: Everything Amity MA Clinical in one book

chapters.title: Amity, MA Clinical Psychology: The Entrance, Built to the Exhaustive Syllabus
chapters.blurb: The whole entrance built to the official six-section syllabus and taught from scratch to NIMHANS depth: abnormal psychology & psychopathology, biopsychology, research methods & advanced statistics, psychological testing & psychodiagnostics, psychotherapy & ethics/law, and general & developmental psychology, plus two appendices off your own paper. Read it cover to cover and you walk in ready.
